prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sleek slicked-back teal hair — wearing nothing but a neon pink glossy high-cut bodysuit with a deep front zip pulled open down to the navel and high-cut leg openings rising to the hip bones, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The outfit sits on her skin with soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Pose: standing tall with her legs slightly apart and both hands resting on her hips, chin tilted down, looking down toward the crowd with a calm confident look, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each longer than her middle finger, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: the Dubai waterfront promenade at golden hour with the glittering skyline of skyscrapers behind; her giant stiletto heel stands in the foreground like a monument, with hundreds of tiny visitors in white kanduras, abayas and summer clothes taking photos, tiny cars and tiny tour buses gathered in a crowd around the base of the heel, every person at their true real size and only as tall as the heel is long, all looking up at it; she is a colossal giant, her towering heels planted on the stone promenade, her body rising high above the crowd and the buildings, a glowing golden-orange sunset sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm golden sunset light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from ground level with the camera low among the crowd and tilted upward, her giant stiletto shoe and its slender heel large in the foreground at the bottom of the frame, the whole figure from the heel tips up to the top of her head completely visible rising far above the crowd, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
